_comment: Fabrik devnet source registry. Seeded into DevNetVersion via data migration. URL templates use {pkg} and {class} placeholders. fallback_chain is the order in which versions are tried when a class 404s on the requested version (first entry must equal the version_key itself).

versions.notes: APIC 6.1.x. Bundle is byte-identical to 6.0 — same class list, distinct URL host.
